name: cloudcli-claude-limits
description: CloudCLI UI plugin: a full-width Claude dashboard — plan usage limits with countdown timers, 30-day token/cost history, an active-session table with kill/resume/cleanup, and a Usage view with day/week/month/session grouping and per-project/per-model breakdowns.
author: DrStannum
